claims.evidence: No sidewall text, brand, size, or country-of-origin marking is visible in the photo, so the 'tokunbo' (foreign-used) origin claim cannot be confirmed or denied.

risks.risk: Tire size (width/aspect/rim diameter) unknown, affects fitment and price tier
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the sidewall showing the size code (e.g., 195/65R15)
risks.if_unproven: price as unknown/mixed size, worst-case smallest or least compatible size

risks.risk: Brand/model unknown, budget vs premium brand changes value greatly
risks.proof: Close-up of sidewall brand logo and model name

risks.risk: Manufacture age (DOT code) unknown, old tires are unsafe regardless of tread
risks.proof: Close-up of DOT date code on sidewall
risks.if_unproven: price as oldest plausible age (over 6 years, worst case)

risks.risk: Actual tread depth in mm not confirmed, only visual grooves seen
risks.proof: Photo with tread depth gauge or coin test on each tire

risks.risk: Hidden patches, plugs, bulges, or internal cord damage not visible
risks.proof: Close-up photos of full sidewall circumference and inner liner of each tire

risks.risk: Exact number of tires in the stack unclear
risks.proof: Full photo with all tires countable and separated
risks.if_unproven: price per single tire, not as a full set

risks.risk: Storage conditions (sun exposure, dry rot, cracking) not assessable from this angle
risks.proof: Close-up of sidewall surface showing any cracking or weathering

proof_requests: Close-up of each tire's sidewall showing size, brand, and DOT date code
Full-stack photo with all tires visible and countable
Tread depth measurement photo (gauge or coin) per tire
Close-up of sidewalls for cracks, patches, plugs, or bulges
response.reason: The witness confirms these are used car tires, so they can be priced at worst case for unknown size, brand, age, and condition; the 'tokunbo' claim and specifics remain unverifiable from the photo alone.
